title: Add Chat/typing method to main spec
description: The epic jmap-chat-spec-53o identifies that the client-to-server typing signal is missing from draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md. Need to add a Chat/typing method under Chat Methods that: takes accountId, chatId, typing(bool); instructs server to fan out typing push event to local participants and invoke Peer/typing on remote servers for federated chats; never persists the event; rate-limits per account per chat.
